body:
alex.chang: seeing spikes of SCIM provisioning failures for a subset of customers since 03:02 UTC, looks tied to key rotation window
maria.kim: which errors? 403/429/500?
jordan_p: logs show 500 with 'decrypt failed: context mismatch' from our SCIM worker pool
alex.chang: exactly. snippet:
```
2026-03-19T03:02:14Z scim-worker-7 ERROR decrypt: envelope_decrypt: verification failed (context mismatch)
request_id=ab12cd key_id=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ids/cryptoKeys/scim-key
```
alex.chang: errors started when infra rotated KMS key to new primary + staged previous for 1h
maria.kim: hmm. could be that some workers cached KMS-encrypted tokens (session secrets) with old encryption context (customer_id) formatting changed in the rollout
jordan_p: we changed the envelope format last week to include region tag in context: "cust:${id}|region:${r}"
alex.chang: some tokens show old context (no region), so decrypt fails against new key version's allowed contexts
infra-bot: deployment note: kms/keyRings/ids rotated at 2026-03-19T03:00Z, previous version scheduled to retire 2026-03-19T04:00Z
maria.kim: quick mitigation: requeue affected provisioning jobs so they decrypt against previous key version (still active) or force workers to fetch latest secret without cached ciphertext
jordan_p: can we temporarily extend retirement window on old key? that buys time
alex.chang: requested via infra pager: please extend key version 1 retirement by +2 hours
sec-oncall: approved, extended until 06:00Z. but we should still reconcile RBAC audits — some SCIM failures caused partial group writes
maria.kim: that's the harder part. partial group writes led to inconsistent RBAC: some members added, some not, leaving teams in limbo
alex.chang: I compiled a quick script to detect partial ops and re-run idempotent group syncs:
```
# list recent scim ops with status
cat /var/log/scim/ops.log | jq -r 'select(.status=="partial") | .request_id'
for id in $(./find_partial.sh); do scim-retry --request $id --force; done
```
jordan_p: will run after key extension completes
maria.kim: also, audit logs show KMS key_id present in entries but no encryption context field in some older logs — we should add an alert for missing context during decrypt
alex.chang: adding a quick Prometheus rule: increase anomaly score if decrypt_error_rate > 0.5% AND missing_context_count > 0 in 5m
sec-oncall: action items: (1) infra extended old-key retirement, (2) jordan to requeue/retry partial SCIM ops, (3) alex to add alert and a one-off reconciliation job, (4) maria to follow up with IAM team about envelope context backward-compat
maria.kim: question: do we need to backfill audit events for the 12 customers impacted? compliance might ask for a stamped explanation
alex.chang: yes — I'll produce a signed incident note with timeline + affected customers list and attach KMS rotation justification
jordan_p: ran the retry loop, most ops succeeded, 3 customers still failing due to rate-limit errors from idp side (429)
alex.chang: for those 3, we set per-customer backoff and scheduled retries over 2 hours
infra-bot: monitoring: scim-success-rate returned to baseline by 03:40Z, decrypt_error_rate dropped to 0
maria.kim: follow-up: add unit test to ensure envelope context compatibility across key versions, and add guardrails in rotation workflow to block retirement if >1% active ciphertexts reference old format
sec-oncall: filing postmortem ticket and tagging legal/compliance for audit package
alex.chang: thanks all. i'll post the incident note in #incidents once doc is ready :thumbsup:
maria.kim: nice catch, alex. small change avoided a bigger outage
jordan_p: leaving a short runbook step: "on KMS rotation, trigger scim-worker cache flush and requeue transparently" — PR incoming
alex.chang: PR linked: https://git.internal/redwood/scim/+/4987
infra-bot: note: key rotation automation updated to publish 'context_formats' in rotation event metadata
sec-oncall: closing thread, mark as resolved after postmortem published
